UPDATE workspace_13mbc2c4oiu70a17e1h9z0mxn."_linkedinAccount"
SET
  "connectionSentToday" = COALESCE("connectionSentToday", 0) + 1,
  "lastUsed" = NOW(),
  "updatedAt" = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $('Split Profile Batch').item.json.accountDbId }}';

parameters.content:
### 🔄 How It Works

1️⃣ Trigger
• Runs manually or via schedule.
• Typically executed once daily.

2️⃣ Fetch LinkedIn Accounts
• Retrieves active accounts from Nebula.
• Calculates remaining daily quota:
  remaining = dailyConnectionLimit - connectionSentToday.

3️⃣ Fetch Eligible Learners
• connectionSent = FALSE
• profileUrlPrimaryLinkUrl exists
• deletedAt IS NULL

4️⃣ Allocate Candidates
• Even distribution across accounts.
• Never exceeds remaining quota.
• Extracts LinkedIn publicId from URL.

5️⃣ Send Invitation (Unipile)
• Convert publicId → provider_id.
• Send connection invite.
• Receives invitation_id.

6️⃣ CRM Update
• connectionSent = TRUE
• Store provider_id
• Store invitation_id
• Update connectionSentDatetime
• Increment account counter.

7️⃣ Rate Limiting
• Wait 60–120 seconds.
• Sequential execution (Split in Batches).

# Automate LinkedIn connection requests across multiple accounts
while respecting daily sending limits and preventing duplicates.

## Goals:
• Distribute requests evenly across accounts.
• Prevent exceeding daily connection limits.
• Store full traceability (provider_id + invitation_id).
• Maintain safe rate-limited execution.
• Keep Nebula CRM fully synchronized.

## 🎯 Objective

- This workflow automates sending LinkedIn connection requests
- from multiple accounts while enforcing daily limits,
- ensuring even distribution, and maintaining full CRM traceability
- inside the Nebula (Learner) module.

## ⚙️  Important Notes

• Sequential sending (1 invite at a time).
• Random delay between 60–120 seconds.
• Account limits enforced before allocation.
• Workflow guarantees no duplicate sending.
• Invitation ID stored for webhook-based future updates.
• connectionSentToday must be reset daily.

### LinkedIn Multi-Account Connection Automation

Trigger → Accounts → Quota → Learners → Allocation
→ Split → Get Provider → Invite → IF
→ Update CRM → Update Account → Wait → Loop

Accounts Source: _linkedinAccount
Learner Source: _learner

Unipile Flow:
GET /users/{publicId}
POST /users/invite

Data Stored:
• linkedinProviderId
• linkedinInvitationId
• connectionSentDatetime

Safety:
✓ Daily quota enforcement
✓ Random wait (60–120s)
✓ Sequential processing
✓ CRM state consistency
